cs.t: Recently went from an RPi to a MinisForum HX90 this past year. RPi was running PiHole, Wireguard, a dyndns updater, and the control interface for my old AP via docker(compose) on Ubuntu Server. HX90 is running ProxMox, with VMs for WireGuard and PiHole, and a large Ubuntu VM to run dockerised (docker-compose) applications.  I know ProxMox can do it directly, I just feel more comfortable in control of directories. Thinking about running a web-office server (OnlyOffice, NextCloud or OwnCloud) and connecting that with my NAS... possibly using a Cloudflare Tunnel/argo or ngrok.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's on your home server?
